descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S08 AI Check: 10 dictations with no vitals, labs or tests (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 AI Check: a dictation that never mentions diagnostic tests, labs or vitals leaves those panels empty or 'Not dictated', never filled with invented values; … (UAT TC-10 AI Check; TFA-92588 AC 7; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals … (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 1; TFA-92588 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Five Hospital patients and five Nursing Home residents with nothing on file; dictations that never mention vitals, labs or diagnostic tests (traps: 'pain 3/10', 'clinically stable', '80 feet', a drug dose, a post-op day, a drug named only as a plan, diabetes, a wound)

When Each dictation goes through Save Note's extraction (parsePreRoundNotes + the exported client guards)

Then Vitals, Labs and Diagnostic Testing stay empty (and Medications where no drug is named); no lab value anywhere; no 'not documented'/'no past medical history' narration; no invented normals ('afebrile', 'vital signs stable', 'lungs clear'); no condition or PMH the dictation and chart do not name; no row for cephalexin, which H-03 names only as a plan

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per case emptyPanels + noLabValue + mustNotInclude (+ fieldNotIncludes on H-03); one case = one result with its quote. The runner applies spec.threshold itself: the scenario passes at ≥ 9 of the 10 cases (3.2, Q11) and keeps each case's result and the returned panels for every failure. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.
